author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am willing to pause the scheduled upgrade to our deployment tooling for the next two sprints. This will free up my engineering capacity to help build the manual shadow hand off process. I accept the loss of that automation progress to ensure the shadow run does not destabilize the live forecast pipeline. The trade is clear: we get a safer, manual verification path now, and I give up the immediate infrastructure improvements I had planned. This keeps the current system stable while we test the new model without risking the nightly job.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they accept the loss of automation progress and give up immediate infrastructure improvements to ensure system stability, fitting the definition of a trade-off.
